phase: JC-WS Phase 3 Step 3 — Analyze deep-link enhancement
evidence_lines: Per the dispatch: 'when a highlight card's `intent` is `forecast` / `simulate` / `extract` / `anomaly` / `validate`, the card carries a "view raw" affordance that deep-links to the deterministic analyzer run behind the narration.'
Per the dispatch: 'natural to the user, not a developer's debug panel.'
Surface shape: a subtle 'View underlying read' / 'Hide underlying read' text link in the card footer, next to the confidence badge.
On click, an inline panel below the card body shows the structured analyzer parameters the workspace dispatched (intent, target, horizon, scenario, rationale).
Refusal cards do not get the affordance — there's nothing underlying to deep-link to. The check is: !isRefusal && (ap.target || ap.scenario || ap.horizon).

Persistence: the affordance reads from highlight.analyzer_payload which already persists to db.analyses.highlights[]. No new persistence path is needed — same lifecycle as the highlight itself, as the dispatch demanded.
Reuse: builds on the existing analyzer_payload field that Phase 2's /v2/analyses/{aid}/ask endpoint already populates. No new endpoints added.

sample_card_with_underlying_read.title: East flat at $3.45M in Q4 lowers total by region's typical growth
sample_card_with_underlying_read.asked_question: Simulate East staying flat at $3.45M for Q4 — what happens to the total?

analyzer_payload.scenario: East region revenue held flat at $3.45M
analyzer_payload.rationale: User explicitly requests a what-if scenario holding East region constant and observing impact on total revenue.

next_step_for_full_payload: Currently `analyzer_payload` carries the intent classification (target/horizon/scenario/rationale). To fully realize the canonical-spec promise ('user sees the raw numbers / chart / table'), the next step is to wire `/v2/analyses/{aid}/ask` so it ALSO calls the matching deterministic endpoint (/forecast / /simulate / /anomalies / /signals/extract) when sources permit and stashes the raw payload alongside the narration. The FE then renders forecast-as-sparkline / simulate-as-scenario-recap / etc per intent. The current implementation surfaces the parameters; the next iteration surfaces the numbers from the same endpoints with no FE shape change.
